# `storage/KernelMetadataReadback.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/storage/KernelMetadataReadback.js`

Encrypted readback snapshot for the structured `webgpu-os` metadata DB. Non-extractable CryptoKeys and native directory handles are represented by safe descriptors; their browser security boundary is intentionally retained.
